input.quote: Upon the date of termination, all Customer payment obligations accrued hereunder through the date of termination will become due and payable. The termination of selected Service Option Attachments will not affect Customer's obligation to pay charges under other Service Option Attachments.
input.rationale: Section 3.5 (Effect of Termination) deals only with Customer's accrued payment obligations; it contains no transition assistance, no return or export of Content (the defined term for our data), and no deletion mechanic. Sections 14.18 (Data Protection), 11.6 (Content) and 14.2 (Survival) were checked and none provides exit assistance or data return, and no other clause in the Agreement addresses migration, retrieval or deletion of Content. In a hosting agreement this absence is a deviation from the fallback as well as the preferred position, so we insert a single exit paragraph at the preferred level: up to six months' assistance at then-current rates, return of Content within 30 days in a standard machine-readable format, and certified deletion after return.

proposal.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations in Section 3.5
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only Customer's payment obligations on termination, so we added our standard exit terms: up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a standard machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion after return. We can accept a 90-day assistance period with the same 30-day export as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will: (a) at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days after such expiry or termination, return all Content to Customer in a standard machine-readable format; and (c) after such return, delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.

mappings.element: Transition obligations apply on expiry or termination.
Vendor provides transition assistance for up to six months.
Transition assistance is charged at then-current rates.
Vendor returns Customer Data within 30 days after expiry or termination.
Customer Data is returned in a standard machine-readable format.
Vendor certifies deletion of Customer Data after its return.
